svg.title: Compare storage connectivity patterns
svg.desc: A two-node switchless example has two direct storage links between nodes. The switched example uses separate paths through switches A and B. Management and compute access is omitted in both diagrams and still requires its own design. This is a conceptual comparison, not a cabling blueprint.
svg.text: Read each topology left to right. Solid blue: path A. Dashed purple: path B.
Management and workload access still needs its own switches and redundancy.
Use the exact supported pattern; the cited two-node switchless patterns require redeployment to add nodes.
Separate storage ports and converged host ports are different choices from switched versus switchless.
Conceptual paths only: management links, workload uplinks, and switch interconnects are not shown.
